impact.text: A user bonded for an entire epoch receiving 0% of their share violates this guarantee.

precondition_sources.text: The user was bonded for part or all of epoch N.

intent_sources.text: Rewards are allocated pro rata to users' shares of the total bonded balance, so a user bonded during an epoch must receive their proportional share rather than zero.

The reward calculation must capture the user's non-zero bonded balance at the moment just before lock expiry (locked.end - 1) when the lock expires within the epoch, giving proportional credit for time bonded during that epoch.
